global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a dark wood table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with smooth, slightly reflective surface and subtle grain patterns visible.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white interior and blue scalloped rim with repeating wave-like patterns along its edge.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, pale yellow strands, rich brown liquid, and toppings like green onion and bean sprouts.
regions.meat: The chashu pork displays a glossy, caramelized crust over tender, layered pink meat with visible fat marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, fibrous, sliced pieces with slightly curled edges and visible grain texture.
